description_en: Queries the route entries of an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）路由条目
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterRouteEntries

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The region where the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance resides
parameters.help_zh: 专线网关实例所属地域
parameters.name: query_region_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The AS path traversed by the route entry
parameters.name: as_path

parameters.help_en: The community value carried by the BGP route entry
parameters.name: community

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
For the first query or when no subsequent query is required, leave this parameter empty.
If a subsequent query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether it is a dry run for this request. Valid values:

true: sends a check request and does not modify EPS resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: The status code that indicates whether the call is successful. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. For more information about the cause of failure, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace `%s` in the ErrMessage error message.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned. Valid values: 1 to 2147483647. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量。取值范围：1～2147483647。默认值：10

Message.description_en: The message returned for the instance operation

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is required.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

AsPath.description_en: The AS path traversed by the route entry

Community.description_en: The community value carried by the BGP route entry

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

Med.description_en:
The MED value carried by the BGP route entry, which takes effect for routing between the Express Connect Router (ECR) and the TR. 
The MED value can be set to 2000. After the configuration, the TR and the Express Connect Router (ECR) serve as the default path. 
For a non-default path, the MED value is empty. 
For TRs in the same Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN), only one associated object can have the MED value set to 2000
Med.description_zh:
BGP路由条目携带的MED值，作用于专线网关与TR之间。 
MED可配置为2000（配置后则此TR与ECR作为Default路径） 
非Default路径时，此MED值为空 
同一个CEN的TR只能有一个关联对象的MED为可配置为2000

NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region where the next hop instance resides
NexthopInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 下一跳实例所属的地域

Status.description_en: The status of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
True: The call was successful.
False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
